caption: The drawing depicts a tall, ornately designed wooden chest of drawers, commonly known as a highboy. The highboy is composed of two main stacked sections. The upper section features five drawers with decorative brass handles, framed by an elaborately carved pediment with scrollwork and a central openwork crest. Flanking the crest are two finials atop the corners. The lower section has three drawers with similar brass handles and a central drawer that displays an intricate carved motif resembling a leaf or fan. The entire piece rests on four cabriole legs with carved knees and claw-and-ball feet. The wood is rendered in a reddish-brown tone with visible grain patterns, while the surface of the brass handles adds a muted gold accent. The background is plain and off-white, providing contrast to the detailed and richly colored furniture piece, and there are no other objects or decorations present in the composition.
title: Highboy
